name: ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge
description: Large-scale image classification benchmark originally used for the ILSVRC challenge, centered on recognizing object categories in natural images.
evaluation_method: top-1 accuracy, top-5 accuracy, and localization error depending on task track
typical_sota_score: approximately 90%+ top-5 accuracy on classification tracks
notes: A foundational benchmark in computer vision; often used for pretraining and representation learning. The benchmark is static, but the challenge format evolved over time.
